summary: Priyanka Sharma works in Indology. She completed an M.Phil at Mahatma Gandhi Antarrashtriya Hindi Vishwavidyalaya (2011–2012) and served as an Assistant Professor at Lovely Professional University from 2018 to 2019.

Priyanku Chakraborty is a scholar in Buddhist studies, Indology, and history and archaeology. He conducted doctoral studies under supervisor Aishwarya Biswas (attested 2026) and held posts at The Asiatic Society in 2022 and as Rajendralal Mitra RF in Buddhist Studies (attested 2026).
Priyavrat Sharma (1920–2008) worked in Indology and history and archaeology. He served as Director at Banaras Hindu University and Director of its Postgraduate Institute of Indian Medicine.

Prods Oktor Skjærvø is a linguist and Iranian studies scholar. Educated at Oslo (PhD 1981) under Georg Morgenstierne, the Sorbonne, and Mainz (Dr. habil. 1984), he held chairs at Mainz (1980–1985) and Harvard (circa 1991–2015), and edited the Encyclopædia Iranica (1984–1991).

Prudence R. Myer (1920–2001) was a scholar of history, archaeology, Indology, and Buddhist studies. She earned her PhD from the Institute of Fine Arts, NYU, and taught at Mount Holyoke (1956), Tulane (1959–1963), and UC Santa Barbara (1966–1968).
Przemysław Szczurek specializes in Indology. He held a post at Adam Mickiewicz University in Poznań and was attested in 2021 as Professor of Indology at the University of Breslau.

Puji Sulani works in Buddhist studies, religious studies, and history and archaeology. She earned an M.Pd. at the State University of Jakarta (2012–2014) and a doctorate at the University of Indonesia (2018–2023), holding a post at Sekolah Tinggi Agama Buddha Negeri Sriwijaya (2009).

Pulinbihari Chakravarti was an Indologist and philosopher who studied under Jogendranath Vedantatirtha and Satkari Mookerjee. He served as Curator of Manuscripts at The Asiatic Society (attested 1951).
Punyavijaya (1895–1971) was a scholar of Indology and religious studies who studied under Sukhlal Sanghvi and founded the Prakrit Text Society.

Purna Harsha Bajracharya specialized in history, archaeology, and Buddhist studies. In 1972, he is attested as Chief Research Officer at both the Archaeological Survey of India and the Department of Archaeology.

Purnima Dhavan is a historian and Indologist. She studied at the University of Michigan (1996) and the University of Virginia (1998, 2003), and held posts at Bowdoin College (2002–2003), St. John's University (2003–2005), and the University of Washington (from 2005).

Purushottam Mahadev Joshi (1904–1989) was a scholar of Indology, history, and archaeology. He held posts at the University of Mumbai Library (circa 1935–1947) and Deccan College Post-Graduate and Research Institute as Reader in Medieval History (circa 1965–1970).

Purushottam Vishvanath Bapat (1894–1991) was an Indology and Buddhist studies scholar. Educated at the University of Mumbai (MA circa 1917–1919) and Harvard (PhD circa 1928–1932), he held posts at Fergusson College, Visva-Bharati University, and the University of Delhi.

Purushottama Bilimoria is a scholar of philosophy, Indology, and religious studies. Educated under Shivesh Thakur and at La Trobe University (PhD), he held appointments at Deakin University (2001–2009) and the University of Melbourne (2001–2016), alongside visiting roles at Columbia and Stony Brook.

Pushpendra Kumar (b. 1936) is an Indologist who studied under Satya Vrat Shastri. He held positions as Lecturer in Sanskrit at the University of Delhi (attested 1976) and Principal at Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri National Sanskrit University.
Puthezhethu Rama Menon (1891–1973) was an Indology scholar who served as a Judge at the Chief Court of Cochin and as President of the Kerala Sahitya Akademi.
Pyi Phyo Kyaw is a Buddhist studies scholar who completed a PhD at King's College London in 2014 and later served there as a postdoctoral research fellow (attested 2017).

Pál Büchler (1877–1946) was an Indologist who completed his education and earned a Ph.D. at Eötvös Loránd University between 1897 and 1907. He later served as a Professor at the Commercial School in Târgu-Mureș from 1926 to 1930.

Péter-Dániel Szántó is an Indology, Buddhist studies, and Tibetology scholar. Educated at ELTE and Oxford under Alexis Sanderson, he held posts at Merton College, Hamburg, All Souls College, Leiden, and ELTE, where he became Associate Professor and Head of Department in 2022.
Qian Cao is a scholar in Indology and philosophy. Attested in 2026, they are a PhD student and faculty member at Ghent University.
